P.name: Flurry
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Lee Sin's''' next 2 {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} within 3 seconds gain {{sti|attack speed|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and restore {{sti|{{as|energy}}}}.

The first attack restores {{as|{{pp|20 to 40 for 3|1 to 13}} energy}} and the second attack restores{{ft|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20 for 3|1 to 13}} energy}}.|half of the previous amount.}}

Q.name: Sonic Wave
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' fires a sonic blast in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and marks them for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: While the target is marked, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''{{ai|Resonating Strike|Lee Sin}}''.

Q.name: Resonating Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|dashes}} to the nearby enemy marked by ''{{ai|Sonic Wave|Lee Sin}}''. Upon arrival, he consumes the mark and deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: ''The marked enemy must be within range in order to cast this ability. {{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Cripple|Lee Sin}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Safeguard
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied unit's location. If the ally is a {{tip|champion}} upon arrival, both they and '''Lee Sin''' gain a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds.
If the target is a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|ward}}, '''Lee Sin''' also shields himself.
'''Lee Sin''' can [[self-targeted|self-cast]] ''Safeguard'' to shield himself.
W.description2: After ''Safeguard'' is cast, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''{{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}}'' within the next 3 seconds.
W.description3: ''{{ai|Iron Will|Lee Sin}} and {{ai|Cripple|Lee Sin}} can be cast during the dash.''

E.name: Tempest
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' smashes the ground beneath him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, marking them for 4 seconds and, if they are not {{tip|invisible}} when struck, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for the same duration.
E.description2: If ''Tempest'' hits an enemy, '''Lee Sin''' can cast ''{{ai|Cripple|Lee Sin}}'' within the next 3 seconds after a {{fd|0.1}}-second delay.

E.name: Cripple
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|slow|slows}} nearby enemies marked by ''{{ai|Tempest|Lee Sin}}'', decaying in strength over 4 seconds.
E.description2: ''A nearby marked enemy is required to cast this ability.''

R.name: Dragon's Rage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lee Sin''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy champion over the cast time, then roundhouse kicks them to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} {{tt|up to 800 units|see notes}} {{tt|over {{fd|0.8}} seconds|Estimated}}, rendering them {{tip|airborne}} for 1 second.
R.description2: Enemies that collide with the displaced enemy while it is {{tip|airborne}} take the same damage plus {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Collision Physical Damage|{{ap|175 to 625}} {{as|(+ 200% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12 to 18}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: If ''Dragon's Rage'' kills the primary target, it will still knock them back, causing the target's corpse to be displaced and collide with enemies it passes through.
